text: Design a staged and outcome-aligned commercial model for AI transformations
description: Define paid diagnostic, bounded pilot, operational rollout, and continuing autonomy stewardship. Compare fixed-fee, subscription, and verified outcome-linked components. Require positive delivery margin after model, integration, support, and supervision costs; owner exit rights and data portability; and explicit responsibility boundaries. Never bill or claim success based on agent activity or simulated credits.
reflection: Created meta/ai-transformation-commercial-model.md. Defined diagnostic, pilot, rollout, stewardship, and optional capped outcome components; conservative delivery-margin acceptance rules; outcome-attribution safeguards; ownership/responsibility boundaries; anti-consultancy-drift metrics; client qualification; and a five-owner first commercial test. Price bands are labeled unvalidated hypotheses. Synthetic activity and mock revenue are explicitly excluded. Verification: git diff --check passed and all required commercial/economic safeguards are present.

status.comment: Staged, outcome-aligned commercial model drafted and internally checked; price bands remain explicit hypotheses for owner validation.
